entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves are at peak[n]popularity! Everyone wants us to[n]hurry up and do something.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ugh, it sucks having people try[n]and order us around like that...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Is this just how things are[n]gonna be from now on?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: But either way, I don't think we[n]can just ignore the expectations[n]people have of us.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Yes, this is the path we chose.[n]We'll just have to turn a blind[n]eye to the criticism.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: Learning about the existence[n]of the Phantom Thieves is what[n]gave me the courage to fight.

entries.speaker: Haru
entries.en: I can only hope the people[n]saying these horrible things[n]about us are few in number.
